title: Base64 Image Viewer
h1: Base64 Image Viewer — Preview Base64 Images
seoTitle: Base64 Image Viewer — Preview Base64 Encoded Images Free
description: Paste a Base64 data URL or raw Base64 string and preview the image instantly. Runs entirely in your browser.
intro: Paste a Base64-encoded image (data URL or raw Base64) to see a live preview. Useful for debugging data URLs and embedded images. Nothing is uploaded.
blurb: Preview Base64-encoded images directly in the browser.
howItWorks: Paste a data URL (data:image/...) or raw Base64 string.
Press Preview. The image appears below if the data is valid.
The image is rendered locally; nothing is sent to a server.
examples: Debug a data URL copied from a browser network tab.
Preview an image embedded as Base64 in an email or document.

faq.a: Any image format the browser can display (PNG, JPG, WebP, GIF, etc.) when provided as a valid Base64 data URL or raw Base64 with a guessed MIME type.
No. Decoding and rendering happen entirely in your browser.
